steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Grammar accuracy is essential for the writing and speaking papers, where it is worth up to 40% of marks. Always check cases, word order and verb endings. | German Exam Tips — Adjective Endings and Pronouns: 1. For Adjective Endings and Pronouns, use a range of vocabulary and complex grammatical structures to access higher marks 2. Check verb tenses, agreements and word order carefully in your written work 3. In translation tasks, translate meaning rather than word-for-word 4. When writing about Adjective Endings and Pronouns, include opinions and justifications, not just descriptions 5. For listening and reading, focus on key words and cognates to extract meaning
